parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for searches in "%KeyWord%" mode. The value is not case-sensitive.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **20**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-dns-cache-domains --lang zh --keyword a --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeDnsCacheDomains --region cn-hangzhou --Keyword a --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --Lang zh
